MOVE-A03.scope: Scene-long target blocking; Jaw Lock blocks both participants until either leaves or faints; normal/forced Switcher effects are prevented. Target exit ends its block; ordinary source departure does not end a whole-scene effect. Run Away remains immune.

Anchor Shot.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Block.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Jaw Lock.effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Blocks both User and Target. Whole Scene Duration.

Mean Look.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Snap Trap.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Spirit Shackle.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Thousand Waves.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Unique. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

MOVE-A04.scope: Ten standard four-round ongoing moves: 2 typeless dice at round end, defenses ignored, first ongoing source only. Blocking is separate; Clamp blocks both participants. Source-defined evasion difficulty remains GM discretion. Cleanse removes the matching ongoing trap, not independent scene blocks.

Bind.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

Ceaseless Edge.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical. Cutter Move. Ongoing Damage with Duration of 4 Rounds.

Clamp.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Block both User and Target. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds.

Fire Spin.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

Infestation.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

Sand Tomb.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

Stone Axe.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical. Cutter Move. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.

Thunder Cage.effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

Whirlpool.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.

Wrap.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.

MOVE-A05.scope: Magma Storm: four-round Blocking and 3 Fire-type damage dice at round end. Salt Cure: four-round 2 typeless dice, super-effective initial damage against Steel/Water and 1 extra ongoing damage against either type. Existing first-source priority and type/protection precedence are retained.

Magma Storm.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Blocks. Roll 3 Fire-Type Damage Dice ignoring defenses at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.

Salt Cure.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Steel-Type and Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move and 1 Extra Damage from the Ongoing Damage.

MOVE-A06.scope: 68 ordinary Physical/Special attacks: existing accuracy, reaction, damage, targeting and printed attribute machinery is retained; no additional native effect exists. Complete the attack after damage while preserving optional item effects. Lethal wounds and narrative clauses remain excluded.

Aerial Ace.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.

Aeroblast.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.

Aqua Cutter.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.

Astral Barrage.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique.

Aura Sphere.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Projectile Move.

Brutal Swing.effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.

Crabhammer.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical

Cross Chop.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical.

Disarming Voice.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.

Egg Bomb.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Projectile Move.

Glacial Lance.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique.

Hyper Voice.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.

Kowtow Cleave.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Never Miss.

Land's Wrath.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique.

Leaf Blade.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.

Magnet Bomb.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Never Miss. Projectile Move.

Mega Punch.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move.

Night Slash.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.

Oblivion Wing.effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.

Overdrive.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.

Psycho Cut.effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.

Razor Leaf.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.

Shadow Punch.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Fist Move.

Stone Edge.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.

Vital Throw.effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. Never Miss.

MOVE-A07.scope: Ten unconditional damaging stat clauses. Uses existing exact Chance pools, six-only success, ability/item modifiers, target protection, reflection, source-owned self changes and nonstacking stat channels.

Leaf Storm.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.

Liquidation.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.

Low Sweep.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.

Lumina Crash.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Foe's Sp. Defense by 2.

Lunge.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.

Metal Claw.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.

Meteor Mash.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to increase the User's Strength by 1.

Moonblast.effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.

Mud Shot.effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.

Mystical Fire.effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Special by 1.

MOVE-A08.scope: Eight Support stat cards: exact printed recipients, typing/weather predicates, non-Ghost Curse, battlefield Grass recipients and Coaching excluding the user. Meditate follows its prose Special/Sp. Defense rather than the inconsistent structured Strength field. Existing stat-protection and nonstacking channels remain.

Meditate.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.

Growth.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.

Gear Up.effect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Strength and Spcial of one Steel-Type of Electric-Type Ally.

Magnetic Flux.effect: Target User and Allies in range. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of Electric-Type or Steel-Type Targets.

Flower Shield.effect: Target battlefield. Increase by 1 the Defense of all Grass-Type Pokemon.

Rototiller.effect: Target Battlefield. Increase by 1 the Strength and Special of all Grass-Type Pokemon.

Curse (Non-Ghost).effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense. Reduce by 1 the User's Dexterity. This effect only works if the User is not Ghost-Type.

Coaching.effect: Target All Allies in Range. Increase by 1 the Strength and Defense of all Allies targeted. The User cannot target itself.

MOVE-A09.scope: Ten attacks with defense/critical/weather rules: ignores defenses, Special damage resisted with Defense without changing category, existing AlwaysCrit and Weather Ball type/+2 weather dice. Ordinary completion retains held-item effects; historical adoption stays unchanged.

Sacred Sword.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Defenses.

Psyshock.effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.

Psystrike.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move is resisted with the Foe's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.

Secret Sword.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Apply the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense to resist the Damage from this Move.

Frost Breath.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.

Storm Throw.effect: Single Target. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.

Wicked Blow.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Fist Move. If the Accuracy Roll is successful, this Move becomes a Critical Hit.

Flower Trick.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.

Weather Ball.effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *If there is a weather condition on the field, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. This Move's type will change according to the Weather. Sun/Fire, Rain/Water, Hail or Snow/Ice, Sand/Rock, Wind/Flying.

MOVE-A10.scope: Eleven Accuracy-success reductions, including five exact Chance pools and Spacial Rend minus five. Reduces successes, not pool dice. Strongest loss applies without stacking; scene-local lifecycle, Keen Eye, Clear Amulet, Mirror Armor, decoys, shields and Shield Dust retained. Narrative effects remain GM-managed.

Flash.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Kinesis.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Sand Attack.effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Smokescreen.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Mud Slap.effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.

Spacial Rend.effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Unique. If successful, reduce 5 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the Target. Whole scene duration.

Leaf Tornado.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.

Mud Bomb.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.

Muddy Water.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.

Night Daze.effect: Single Target. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the foe. Outside of battle, obscuring effects last for a whole scene.

Octazooka.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.

MOVE-A11.scope: Four explicitly stacking stat cards: Sharpen, Syrup Bomb, Luster Purge and Mist Ball. Each named stat effect stacks to three; exact Chance pools, live reflection/protection and standard other-move nonstacking channels remain. Scene-local counters clear with modifiers or departure.

Sharpen.effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times.

Syrup Bomb.effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 Times.

Luster Purge.effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce Sp. Defense by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times per Target.

Mist Ball.effect: Single Target. Unique. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Special by 1. *This Effect can be stacked up to 3 times per target.

MOVE-A12.scope: Rapid Spin raises user Dexterity and clears its ongoing damage/Leech Seed and its side hazards/terrains. Ice Spinner and Steel Roller remove active terrains; Steel Roller requires a terrain at declaration. Cleanup retains opposing side effects and pure scene Blocking, including shared/global scopes.

Rapid Spin.effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.

Ice Spinner.effect: Single Target. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.

Steel Roller.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.

MOVE-A13.scope: Seven source/context attacks. Current source main/secondary typing determines four move types; Terrain Pulse takes the active applicable terrain type and two dice; Psyblade gains two dice in Electric Terrain; Acrobatics loses two pool dice while holding an item. Existing STAB, immunity, resistance, snapshots and ability conversions retained.

Acrobatics.effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.

Ivy Cudgel.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.

Raging Bull.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible, otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances and STAB accordingly.

Multi-Attack.effect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's type will change to match the User's Main Type.

Revelation Dance.effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.

Psyblade.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.

Terrain Pulse.effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if there is a Terrain active in the Battlefield. Change this Move's Type to match that of a currently active Terrain (ie Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, etc.).

MOVE-A14.scope: Five stat/Blocking cards. Belly Drum rolls half current HP as typeless self-damage dice; Clangorous Soul half total HP rounded down; Fillet Away deals two self damage. No Retreat blocks the user and Octolock blocks the target independently of protected stat changes. Ordinary indirect protection and stat channels retained.

Belly Drum.effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strength by 3.

Clangorous Soul.effect: Target Self. User deals Damage Dice to itself equal to Half of its Total HP rounded down. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.

Fillet Away.effect: Target Self. Deal 2 Damage to the User. Increase the User's Strength, Dexterity and Special by 2.

No Retreat.effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.

Octolock.effect: Single Target. Block. Reduce by 1 the Target's Defense and Sp. Defense.

MOVE-A15.scope: Taunt prevents Support Pokemon moves for four rounds while preserving Support Maneuvers. Throat Chop prevents Sound moves for the scene across switching. Imprison prevents foes from using the active caster's current known moves and ends on caster departure/faint. Authority, immunity and GM clearing remain explicit.

Taunt.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.

Throat Chop.effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.

Imprison.effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.

MOVE-A16.scope: Four history-dependent moves with saved accepted Pokemon move attempts and entry rounds. Disable selects only the last recorded target move and replaces its prior disable; Torment excludes last-round moves for four rounds; Blood Moon/Gigaton Hammer fail if used last round, including Clash attempts. Gigaton Hammer's discretionary Steel bonus remains an explicit GM pool modifier.

Disable.effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.

Torment.effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.

Blood Moon.effect: Single Target. If this Move was used on the previous Round, it fails (Clashing counts as using the Move.)

Gigaton Hammer.effect: Single Target. Lethal. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round. *This Move may deal 2 Extra Damage Dice to Steel-Type Pokemon at Storyteller's Discretion.

MOVE-A17.scope: Four shield-bypassing attacks retain exact printed attributes. Mighty Cleave also bypasses Force Fields; Hyperspace Hole/Fury retain existing Force Field bypass; Hyper Drill still takes applicable Force Field reduction. Hyperspace Fury reduces user Defense by one. Other weather/environment reductions remain.

Hyper Drill.effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ignore Shield Moves active on the Foe or their side of the field.

Hyperspace Hole.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Unique. Ignore Defenses. Ignore Shield Moves and Force Field.

Mighty Cleave.effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Shield Moves & Force Fields active on the foe or their side of the field.

Hyperspace Fury.effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Ignores the effect of any Force Field or Shield Move active on the foe's side. Reduce the User's Defense by 1.

MOVE-A18.scope: Nine range/immunity attacks. Existing specific charge vulnerabilities retained; canonical Freeze Dry resolves the Dive card's Freeze-Dry spelling and is super-effective against Water. Origin Pulse/Precipice Blades hit hidden charging targets and ignore immunity to their printed damage type. Smack Down/Thousand Arrows remove Ground immunity for the scene, ending on departure. Weather activation guards, Shields and Force Fields remain independent.

Earthquake.effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.

Gust.effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.

Sky Uppercut.effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.

Surf.effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.

Freeze Dry.effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.

related_sources.name: Dive
related_sources.effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.

Origin Pulse.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Water-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using a Move, this Move hits anyways.

Precipice Blades.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's Immunity to Ground-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using any Move, this Move hits anyways.

Smack Down.effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.

Thousand Arrows.effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Ground. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves of those affected. Whole Scene Duration.

ruling.review: Extracted definitions: Blocking prevents escape/recall/switching and Switcher effects; ongoing damage is 2 typeless dice, first source only.

snap_trap.decision: Printed prose and icons show scene Blocking only. Remove unsupported OngoingDamage metadata in the application correction layer.
